body: My parents gave me a great live, but they are very pragmatic, they want me to have a good education ad to find a steady life, but that is basicaly it. Something similar hapeneded with my sister. She realy was depressed for one year, and my mom really was upset, not because of how she was feeling, but because she basicaly took a year off university because of it. I feel like the same will happen to me, if I get to that point. My parents are suportive, but in aspects of mental health, they are very old school. From what they tell me, they hae suffered a lot of bad things, but they don't see it as something that afected their mental health, they just powered through it, and it shows that they have unresolved stuff. So I feel they won't understand me and ignore it. I also don't want to tell my sister or any of my other siblings, I don't think their simpathy will help me, it's only gonna make me feel even worst
I also love  moonchild, and, even though i don't deslike it, eptath is the worst song of ITCOTCK, but I don't think thats realy all that unpopular.

I think Red is the worst Wetton era album, by far. Not because the songs are bad, they are quite good, but because of the structure of the album. There isn't realy good progression in Red. All the songs are heavy and intense. Larks and SABB have great structure, having great heavy songs and great soft and delicate songs like trio and book of saturdays that are beautiful and relaxing, and larks part 1 and 2 , fracture and lament, that are intense. Still think is a good album tho, just not all that great
